findings.detail: Threshold-selected dev Wilson bound pools four dependent queries per episode; it is not a coverage-adjusted population reliability certificate.
Dynamics bootstrap is conditional on fixed checkpoints; no population-of-seeds inference or simultaneous two-contrast coverage.
Fused adapter omits J/G/b consumed by ContentModel but unused by AddressedModel; context is restricted to addressed calls.
Nested encoder train folds improve fitting discipline; six previously exposed validation actors remain development evidence.

limits: Intervals conditional on these three checkpoints and this generator
Factorization removes association at observed boundaries and retains p(state)
Two unadjusted contrast intervals do not form a simultaneous 95 percent family
Dev Wilson statistic is a threshold-selection heuristic; four within-episode queries and threshold scanning preclude a population reliability certificate
Historical comparison changes missing-data supervision while preserving equal updates, not equal CPU
Explicit typed prior and finite generator remain

strict_gate_summary.reason: At least one required selective-correctness or known-coverage condition fails; unavailable-answer accuracy is not a recovery success criterion

limits: Same-weight equivalence and timing only; no retraining
Restricted to AddressedModel consumed outputs; cannot replace full ContentModel preparation
Local complete-model median timing gate, not production tails or an ordinary-model speed advantage
Six historically exposed validation actors; development only
No new raw-video acquisition or independent frontend qualification
Encoder folds are nested by actor; relation heads train on nested out-of-fold train probabilities
Bootstrap over six development actors is descriptive, not independent population confirmation

scope: Independent source reading and saved-output reconstruction; not an independent model implementation or rerun
